#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, w;
    cin >> n >> w;
    
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    
    vector<int> cuts;
    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) even++;
        else odd++;
        if (even == odd) cuts.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
    }
    
    vector<int> dp(w + 1, 0);
    for (int cost : cuts) {
        for (int j = w; j >= 1; j--) {
            if (cost <= j) {
                int with = dp[j - cost] + 1;
                if (with > dp[j]) dp[j] = with;
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << dp[w] << "\n";
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
